title: JNU Jawaharlal Nehru University Non Teaching Post 2026 Online Form
postName: Non-Teaching Posts – Group A, B & C (Advt. No. 01/RC(NT)/2026)
vacancyDetails: 267 Non-Teaching vacancies including MTS, Stenographer, Junior Assistant and other Group A/B/C posts as per official advertisement
qualification: Post-wise: 10th / 12th / Graduation / Post Graduation as per JNU Non-Teaching 2026 notification

shortDescription: JNU Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 – 267 Group A/B/C posts. Apply online at jnunt.samarth.edu.in. Last date 27 July 2026 (5:00 PM).
content:
Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), New Delhi has released Advertisement 01/RC(NT)/2026 for various Non-Teaching Group A, B and C posts.

Total vacancies: 267 (MTS, Stenographer, Junior Assistant and more). Online applications opened from 29 June 2026. Last date to apply is 27 July 2026 till 5:00 PM (confirm on portal if any extension).

Apply only on the official portal jnunt.samarth.edu.in. No offline or email applications are accepted.
